In this practical guide, we share nine basic principles that may seem counterintuitive at first glance, but are so simple and effective that changing the tone of your voice and adjusting the types of questions you ask your counterpart can turn things around and make life easier. These negotiation techniques have been tested in a variety of situations and proven effective by countless people. From exciting FBI case stories set in the gangster streets of Haiti to a tragic bank robbery in Brooklyn, New York, to corporate clients using negotiation skills to increase profits by millions of dollars, to MBA students getting themselves better jobs, to parents relying on Voss's methods to deal with their children. Whether you are a housewife or a CEO of a multinational corporation, wherever you need to communicate, you need negotiation skills!
